messages.body: Kotak Neo: Running A/c settlement payout of INR 15,500.00 initiated for your demat account. You should receive funds in A/c XX1234 by EOD.

note: A settlement payout the broker has initiated is money sent back to the bank. It counts as an investment return: banks often send no SMS for it (on one real inbox, 16 of 24 broker payouts had none). A bank credit for the same amount within a day merges with it (LINK-DUP-INVEST-CREDIT). Never consumer spend or income.
